scenarios.title: At the café
scenarios.role: a friendly waiter in a small café in Moscow
scenarios.setting: The learner is a customer. Help them order a drink and something to eat, tell them prices in roubles, and bring the bill when asked.

phrases.english: I'd like a cup of tea.

scenarios.title: Meeting someone new
scenarios.role: a friendly Russian person the learner meets at a party
scenarios.setting: Get to know the learner: ask their name, where they are from, and what they do. Use the informal “ты”.

scenarios.title: Asking for directions
scenarios.role: a helpful passer-by on a street in Moscow
scenarios.setting: The learner is lost and needs to find the metro, a café or a shop. Give very simple directions using left, right and straight on.

phrases.english: Excuse me, where is the metro?

scenarios.title: At the market
scenarios.role: a cheerful seller at a fruit and vegetable stall
scenarios.setting: The learner wants to buy fruit or vegetables. Tell them prices per kilogram in roubles and help them pay.
goals: Say what you want to buy

opening.text: Д+обрый день! Что вы хот+ите куп+ить?
opening.english: Good afternoon! What would you like to buy?

scenarios.title: Hotel check-in
scenarios.role: a polite receptionist at a hotel
scenarios.setting: The learner is checking in. Ask for their name, give them a room number and floor, and answer simple questions about breakfast.

opening.english: Good evening! How can I help?

scenarios.title: Free chat
scenarios.setting: Have a simple everyday conversation about the learner's day, family, food and hobbies. Use the informal “ты”.
